load_and_preprocess_data: load and preprocess computational and experimental CSV data with XRD matching for CO2R or HER analysis
get_and_apply_xrf_mapping: apply XRF composition mapping from XRF data to experimental data and filter out null entries
get_distance_between_formulas: compute the euclidean distance between two chemical composition formulas like Pt-0.5-Pd-0.5
get_production_rate: convert Faradaic efficiency and current density into a production rate in mol per cm squared per second
add_cv_categories: add leave-one-out and leave-one-composition-out cross-validation category columns to a dataframe for ML training
